issue.title: bob task reconcile silently deletes non-task lines between tasks inside a generated status group

task_type_fields.impact:
Silent data loss of user-authored lines in any area/project note whose generated status
group holds a non-task line between two tasks (a jotted plain bullet, prose, a comment).
It contradicts the original design (plan:202609/task_status_groups.md: "Valid plain prose
inside an established managed group stays with that group"). Either preserve interior
pieces or fail closed (ownership_collision) when a group body holds non-whitespace content
between tasks. The marker-free status-group design in
research:202610/task_status_group_markers.md removes the bug by construction, because group
bodies may then hold only tasks and blank lines.
task_type_fields.repro:
Root cause: `split_group_prose` (src/native/task_status_groups/parse.rs) keeps only the
`DirectPiece::Other` runs *before the first* and *after the last* task of a marked group;
`grouping_plan`/`emit_group` (emit.rs) then rebuild the group from `leading + tasks + trailing`,
so any non-whitespace Other piece *between* two tasks is silently discarded. Nothing is warned.

Repro (temporary unit test through `transform` with the standard `#task` classification;
reproduced on master a55a22e, 2026-10-12):

1. Plain bullet between done tasks, nothing else changes:
   input `### Done & Canceled` + `<!-- bob:task-status-group:v1:closed -->` + blank +
   `- [x] #task a` / `- remember to email Alice` / `- [x] #task b`
   -> output keeps both tasks, deletes `- remember to email Alice`, `changed=true`, `warnings=[]`.
2. Prose between tasks: `Leading prose.` / `- [*] #task a` / blank / `Middle prose.` / blank /
   `- [/] #task b` / blank / `Trailing prose.` in a marked Next & In Progress group
   -> `Middle prose.` is deleted; leading and trailing prose survive.
3. A stray `<!-- bob:task-status-group:v1:blocked -->` left between tasks after a heading was
   deleted is dropped the same way, so the documented `malformed_ownership` guard never fires
   for markers inside a group body.

Live vault exposure today: 0 of 264 managed groups contain non-task root content, so no
known loss yet, but `bob task reconcile` runs unattended every 15 minutes.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching marker-free status groups: a probe showed the marker-owned group rewrite drops interior content with no warning, which is silent data loss in an unattended command.
